content: Deterministic lockstep (Gaffer On Games, SnapNet): transmit/record only inputs, each stamped with the frame/tick it applies on; sim cannot advance past a tick without that tick's inputs; a playout-delay buffer smooths jittered input arrival; a 'deterministic fence' separates nondeterministic presentation/input sampling from deterministic simulation; bit-level determinism is not guaranteed across compilers/OS/architectures for floats; physics randomness must be seeded.
